physics-h1-q1.title: Besik superfísie Rai, husi
physics-h1-q1.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-q1.material: Besik superfísie Rai, husi bola-aço A no B husi aas hanesan, A hasai atu monu livre, no B tesi makas horizontálmente. Deklarasaun saida mak loos kona-ba movimentu bola sira? (Ignora rezisténsia ar)

physics-h1-q2.title: Ahun-manu rua ho masa
physics-h1-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-q2.material: Ahun-manu rua ho masa hanesan hasai husi aas hanesan, ida ba rai-semente no seluk ba almofada mamar. Komparasaun kuantidade fízika saida mak loos husi momentu kontaktu ho rai to’o para?
physics-h1-q2.s.s1.prompt: Ahun-manu rua ho masa hanesan hasai husi aas hanesan, ida ba rai-semente no seluk ba almofada mamar. Komparasaun kuantidade fízika saida mak loos husi momentu kontaktu ho rai to’o para?
physics-h1-q2.s.s1.explain: Tanba mudansa momentu linear ($\Delta p$) husi ahun-manu rua hanesan, impulsu forsa ($I = F\Delta t$) hanesan. Almofada estende tempu hasoru $\Delta t$ no hamenus forsa média impaktu $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, tanba nee ahun-manu la kuak.
physics-h1-q2.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-h1-q2.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h1-q3.title: Bola beisebol ho masa
physics-h1-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-q3.material: Bola beisebol ho masa 0,5 kg ba ho velosidade 30 m/s, bati husi taka no fila ba direksaun oposta ho velosidade 40 m/s. Hira mak intensidade impulsu forsa nebé bola simu?

physics-h1-q3.s.s1.explain: Momentu linear inísiu $p_1 = 0.5 \times 30 = +15\text{ kg}\cdot\text{m/s}$, momentu linear final $p_2 = 0.5 \times (-40) = -20\text{ kg}\cdot\text{m/s}$. Intensidade impulsu mak $|\Delta p| = |-20 - 15| = 35\text{ N}\cdot\text{s}$.
physics-h1-q3.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-h1-q3.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h1-c.title: [Mekánika nabilan liu] Husi
physics-h1-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-c.material: [Mekánika nabilan liu] Husi ninin foho ho aas 80 m, objetu ho masa 1 kg tesi horizontálmente ho velosidade 20 m/s. Hira mak distánsia nebé nia kruza iha direksaun horizontál to’o nia to’o rai? (g = 10 m/s², ignora rezisténsia ar)
physics-h1-c.s.s1.prompt: [Mekánika nabilan liu] Husi ninin foho ho aas 80 m, objetu ho masa 1 kg tesi horizontálmente ho velosidade 20 m/s. Hira mak distánsia nebé nia kruza iha direksaun horizontál to’o nia to’o rai? (g = 10 m/s², ignora rezisténsia ar)
physics-h1-c.s.s1.explain: Tempu kuda vertikál mak $80 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times t^2 \implies t^2 = 16 \implies t = 4$ s. Tanba movimentu iha direksaun horizontál mak uniforme, dezlokamentu horizontál mak $x = v_x t = 20\text{ m/s} \times 4\text{ s} = 80\text{ m}$.
physics-h1-c.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-h1-c.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-killer-10.title: Iha esperimentu efeitu fotoelétrikú
physics-killer-10.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-10.material: Iha esperimentu efeitu fotoelétrikú nebé hatudu naroman monokromátiku ba plaka metál, rezultadu mede enerjia sinétika máximu fotoeletrón ba frekuénsia rua hanesan tabela tuir mai.
